Hi Hello

What is your first language? English then French
Favourite food? Probably a Burger
Favourite fruit? Plum

Favourite colour? Gold or Black

How did you find Avicus? I went to the good old internet and searched up Minecraft servers. Then at the homepage of servers, I searched Walls minigame and I saw MCzone01 and MCzone02 and then Avicus came.
